senses.definition: (archaic) Used as a genitive marker in place of ’s after a noun, especially a masculine noun ending in -s, to express the possessive case.
That or those belonging to him; the possessive case of he, used without a following noun.
examples: This pen is his. These books are also his.
The decision was his to live with.
That cough of his is really getting on my nerves.
After our night out, I went back to his.
